note: The ground at 64 px per tile by the motif-scatter route (DECISIONS 2026-10-18, the retry of the text-grid route): Codex draws only the small motifs of docs/design/STYLE.md section 3 as grids, and tools/src/kit/scatter.ts scatters them by a seeded hash across tile edges and bakes the variants as wrapping tiles. One motif at a time: pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/ground-64.json --only meadow_tuft; the whole ground: --only meadow; bake again with no Codex call: --only meadow --reimport. Output in .scratch/kit-gen/ground-64/, nothing goes into content/.

motifs.name: tuft
motifs.detail: 3 to 5 blades 6 to 11 pixels tall, leaning a little different ways, in the two lighter greens #84c450 and #c8e88a, over a darker root of #2e6b3b at the bottom

motifs.name: clover
motifs.what: a small clover of three round leaves
motifs.detail: leaves of #84c450 with a lit top of #c8e88a and a dark #1f3d2b pixel between them

motifs.name: leaf
motifs.what: a single fallen leaf lying on the grass
motifs.detail: a body of #9e6b3c with one light edge of #c99a5e and a dark vein of #6e4226

motifs.name: flower
motifs.detail: a stem of #2e6b3b with one leaf, and a head of 5 to 9 pixels, white #f5f4ef with a yellow #f8de62 middle

motifs.name: ripple

motifs.detail: a dash of 6 to 10 pixels in #c99a5e, broken once, with a lighter #f5f4ef pixel on its crest

motifs.name: pebble
